title: One Rental per Driver under Wayfare Rentals
content:
A driver may hold one Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) rental at a time. A reservation is accepted only when the driver has no rental in reserved, active or return due status and no unpaid balance on an earlier rental.

## The rule as the desk applies it

- **Limit.** One rental per driver; the most rentals one driver may hold in reserved, active or return due status is 1.
- **Unpaid balance on an earlier rental.** A driver with an unpaid balance on an earlier rental may not reserve a new one.
- **What decides it.** The company's rental records for that driver, as they stand before the reservation is accepted: the status of each of the driver's rentals and the balance due on each. The records are matched to the driver making the reservation.
- **What a reservation is.** Each accepted reservation opens a separate rental of its own, recorded with its reservation date.

## Decision table

Because a reservation is accepted *only* when both conditions hold, every combination is decided:

| Driver has a rental in reserved, active or return due status | Driver has an unpaid balance on an earlier rental | Reservation |
|---|---|---|
| No | No | Accepted |
| No | Yes | Not accepted |
| Yes | No | Not accepted |
| Yes | Yes | Not accepted |

## Points of judgement

1. A rental in returned or closed status is not one of the statuses that count toward the limit. It still matters if a balance remains unpaid on it, because that is an unpaid balance on an earlier rental.
2. A rental whose balance due is zero does not carry an unpaid balance.
3. A rental in return due status counts toward the limit just as an active one does.

## Hypothetical drivers

- Driver A's only earlier Wayfare Rentals rental is closed with nothing owed, and Driver A holds no other rental: a new reservation is accepted.
- Driver B returned a vehicle last week; that rental is returned with $40.00 still owed on it: a new reservation is not accepted.
- Driver C holds a reservation for a Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan not yet collected and asks to reserve a Minivan as well: not accepted, since the existing rental is in reserved status.
